case.readyToIssue: Approved. Sign and issue the record to close the case.
case.waitingCitizen: Waiting for the citizen to respond.
case.closedRejected: Closed — rejected with a reason. The citizen can appeal.
case.closedIssued: Closed — record issued to the citizen's DigiLocker.
case.approveBody: {service} for {name}. Your digital signature will be added and the citizen informed.
case.infoBody: Say exactly what's needed, in plain words. The clock pauses until they reply.
case.infoBodyLive: This goes straight to the citizen's Saathi app, in their language. The clock pauses until they reply.
case.plainLanguage: Write as you would speak to them — no rule numbers, no jargon.
case.rejectBody: A rejection must cite the rule and explain why. The citizen sees both and can appeal.
case.explainPlaceholder: What was checked, what didn't meet the rule, and what they can do next.
case.appealNote: The citizen gets an Appeal button that files a grievance with this reasoning attached.

forwardHint.verification: An inspector checks the address or premises in person.
forwardHint.decision: Everything is checked — a senior officer decides.

case.issueBody: The signed record is added to the register and a certified copy is available on request.
case.issueBodyLive: The signed record goes straight into the citizen's DigiLocker and their app shows it as ready.

kyc.subtitle: Where a form and the Aadhaar record disagree. Personal data stays masked until you give a purpose — and the citizen can see that you looked.
kyc.emptyBody: Every open case matches its e-KYC record.
kyc.p1: Masked by default: only the last 4 Aadhaar digits are ever shown, never the full number.
kyc.p2: Purpose first: you choose why before any personal data appears, and it's logged.
kyc.p3: Visible to the citizen: every look appears in their privacy dashboard with your name and purpose.
kyc.accessEmpty: No personal data opened this session.
kyc.lockedBody: Choose why you need to see this applicant's e-KYC record. Your access will be logged with that purpose.
kyc.lockedBodyLive: Choose why you need to see this citizen's e-KYC record. They will see your name, the time and this purpose in their Saathi privacy dashboard.
kyc.loggedLive: Access logged — visible to the citizen
kyc.name: Name
kyc.resolvedAccepted: You accepted the variation — noted on the case.
kyc.resolvedAsk: The citizen has been asked to update their Aadhaar.
kyc.footnote: Data comes from UIDAI e-KYC for {office} only, is never stored outside this case, and is deleted when the case closes.

flags.puccaHouse: I already own a pucca house
flags.pregnant: Pregnant, or a baby in the last year

eligibility.footnote: A quick check from your answers. Saathi confirms with official records when you apply — and never applies without your yes.

pmkisan.ok: You farm land in your name and don't pay income tax.
pmkisan.notFarmer: Only for farmers who own farmland.
pmkisan.noLand: The land has to be in your name.

pmjay.ok: Your family income is in the covered range.
pmjay.secc: Depends on whether your family is on the SECC list — Saathi checks it for you.

pmay.ok: You don't own a pucca house and your income is in range.
pmay.hasHouse: Only for families without a pucca house.
pmay.income: Your income is above the limit.

jsy.ok: Pregnant or a new mother, from a low-income family.
jsy.bpl: In most states only BPL families get it — Saathi checks your state's rule.
jsy.notPregnant: Only for pregnant women and new mothers.

sukanya.ok: You can open a savings account for your daughter.

pmmvy.ok: Pregnant or a new mother — usually for the first living child.
pmmvy.notPregnant: Only for pregnant women and new mothers.

nsp.ok: You're a student within the income limit.
nsp.income: Your family income is above the limit.

apy.ok: You're 18–40 and don't pay income tax.
apy.age: You can join only between 18 and 40.

pmsby.ok: Anyone 18–70 with a bank account can join for ₹20 a year.
pmsby.age70: Covered until 70 — Saathi checks your exact age.

ignoaps.ok: 60 or older, from a low-income family.
ignoaps.bpl: Usually only for BPL families — Saathi checks the list.

mudra.ok: Loans for a small business or trade, with no collateral.
mudra.noBusiness: Only for small businesses and traders.

vishwakarma.ok: Made for traditional craftspeople like you.
vishwakarma.trades: Only for 18 traditional trades — tell Saathi your trade to check.
